macro_objective: Calculate baseline regional rainfall metrics via real-world measurements.

mls_units.title: Community Framework Layout & Container Securement
mls_units.macro_alignment: Sets up safe, approved collection points so the class can gather the rainfall data the baseline is calculated from.

tasks.action: Present the class goal of measuring local rainfall; show a reused plastic bottle cut and marked as a rain gauge.
In mixed pairs, sketch two possible gauge spots on the school grounds and note why each is open to the sky and safe to reach.
Hold a show-of-hands round to pick the two preferred spots, then take them to the Community_Governance_Body for approval.
With the educator present, help fix the approved gauges in place.

mls_units.title: Daily Accumulation Audit & Plotting Rounds
mls_units.macro_alignment: Turns daily gauge readings into the class data set and charts that give the baseline rainfall figures.

tasks.action: Recall from MLS-HYDRO-01: use the two approved gauge spots. In pairs, one reads the morning gauge while the partner records it on the class chart paper; swap roles each day.
Each Friday, total the week's readings with the class and add a bar to the shared rainfall chart.
In groups, work out the weekly average and the wettest day, and explain the method to another group.
End with a 10-minute poster walk where pairs show their chart and baseline figure to a neighbouring class.
